name: Tiled Matrix Multiplication with Shared Memory
definition: A GPU kernel that optimizes matrix multiplication C = A * B by tiling data into block-private shared memory to reduce global memory bandwidth pressure. Matrix A is M×N, B is N×P, and C is M×P.
summary: Tiled Matrix Multiplication with Shared Memory is a GPU kernel that reduces global memory bandwidth pressure by loading tiles into block-private shared memory for reuse, unlike naive kernels that access global memory for every element.
